answer: An identity earns its seat through Registered reflexologist treatment log with reflexologists standing, a proof that is cheap to make once and ruinous to fake at scale. Scale is the enemy of the attacker here: 429 aliases need 429 independent proofs, and one failed proof burns the whole cluster's bond. What carries the forge here is verification, the ember of cost is what stops the farm, and the canyon of the record keeps every claim checkable. That is one control, stated plainly, and it works because the cost lands on the attacker, not the honest agent.
